text: This is the handoff document -- the Enterprise Structure, the subledgers, the Subledger Accounting rules, security, and the FBDI migration, written down for someone who wasn't in the room.
The cost center misallocation gets documented as a named lesson learned, not buried -- exactly which rule, exactly what it did wrong, and exactly how it was found.
The real takeaway: a mapping rule's safe-looking default still has to be checked against every real transaction type it will see, not just the common one.
Theo Branagh owns the configuration during stabilization; Simone Alvarez's team owns the standing monthly reconciliation check going forward, by name, not by assumption.
Next: the final video in this series -- an honest accounting of what shipped, and what's still genuinely manual at Stonefield Distribution.
